blocks.text: PlaneByte is the trading/product name used for the service provided by **Planebyte, an individually operated business owned by Piyush Agrawal**, with its legal-notice/business address at **House No. 1005, Attabira, Bargarh, Odisha 768027, India**, referred to as “PlaneByte,” “we,” “us” or “our.” General service enquiries may be sent to contact@planebyte.com. Formal notices may be sent to that address or contact@planebyte.com. Our business website is https://planebyte.com and the service application is https://app.planebyte.com.

These Terms govern the PlaneByte application and the Intent Radar and Growth Intelligence features made available to your workspace. “You” means the person accepting these Terms and, where that person acts with authority for an organization, that organization. You must be legally able and authorized to enter this agreement. If you act for an organization, you confirm your authority to bind it.

Review these Terms and the Privacy Policy before creating an account or purchasing access. We record acceptance of the applicable version. Do not use the service if you cannot accept the applicable agreement.

New commercial workspace registration requires a company-managed email address. Email/password registration requires verification of mailbox control. Google registration requires a verified Google identity. Existing expressly authorized accounts may continue to use their approved sign-in method. Verification of a mailbox does not establish legal ownership of a company domain or entitle its holder to join every workspace associated with that domain.

Provide accurate account details, protect passwords and developer credentials, and promptly notify us of suspected compromise. Sessions expire after eight hours and can be revoked. Password reset requires a valid recovery process and revokes existing account sessions. Google-only accounts use Google recovery unless a PlaneByte password has been explicitly configured. Connecting an additional sign-in method requires an authenticated linking process; matching email addresses alone do not authorize an automatic merge.

Workspace owners manage invitations, membership and roles, subject to purchased seat capacity and server-side permissions. An invitation requires explicit acceptance by its intended recipient. A shared email domain does not automatically create membership or transfer ownership.

You are responsible for authorized users acting on your behalf, the accuracy and lawful use of information you provide, and the permissions needed to upload or process it. A workspace member's personal account and an organization's workspace records can have different ownership and retention requirements. Changing employment or removing a member does not by itself authorize deletion of the organization's records.

The current offering is Intent Radar and Growth Intelligence. Available features and limits are described in the approved plan comparison and your workspace's authoritative billing and usage view. Lead Engine is reserved for a future release and is not included in this public offering.

Research uses sources that are available and authorized for the relevant workflow. Coverage, freshness and results vary by source, geography and query. Public source availability does not override publisher terms or permissions. We do not promise access to every network, an unrestricted crawl, a particular number of prospects or a commercial outcome.

AI-generated interpretations, scores, profiles, summaries and recommendations may contain errors or omissions. Source quotations and links are evidence to review, not independent verification of a person's employment, identity, buying intent or willingness to receive contact. You remain responsible for reviewing results before relying on them. The service does not supply legal, tax, financial or other regulated professional advice.

Onboarding prepares editable suggestions. Saving a profile or accepting an AI suggestion does not automatically authorize outreach, payment or an unrequested research run. Third-party integrations require their own permissions and may have additional terms. Google sign-in is separate from permission to access a mailbox or other connected service.

An eligible newly verified company account receives one seven-day trial without a card or automatic renewal. The approved trial includes five discovery searches, three shared AI operations, 150,000 reserved AI tokens, one manual monitor and one team member. Scheduled checks, reports, developer API and MCP access require paid access.

One trial is available per verified account and company domain. A second account, workspace or invitation does not create an additional trial entitlement. When the trial expires, paid operations require verified paid access. A paid purchase replaces any remaining trial immediately. Trial allocation does not create a paid subscription, purchase or recurring mandate.

Approved monthly list prices are Starter USD 59, Growth USD 149 and Scale USD 379. Enterprise access requires a separate agreement. Review the selected plan, allowances, charge currency and final total before paying. Prices for yearly access and any annual discount are not yet approved; yearly checkout is unavailable until they are approved and published.

Payments use a one-time PayU-hosted checkout. USD checkout is available only after the specific merchant account's USD charging capability is verified and checkout is enabled. An advertised USD list price does not authorize an undisclosed currency conversion. We do not silently convert the price to INR.

PlaneByte is not currently GST-registered and does not collect GST under the current approved treatment. A purchaser is not required to provide a GSTIN. Any later change to tax registration or applicable tax treatment must be reflected in the applicable order summary before acceptance. We do not describe a payment receipt as a GST tax invoice.

PayU processes payment information on its hosted pages. PlaneByte does not collect card details. A browser success page, callback or payment authorization alone does not activate paid access. Access activates only after independent server-side verification of the matching captured payment. Pending or uncertain payments may require reconciliation. Check payment history before retrying an uncertain payment to avoid another purchase.

sections.title: 7. Fixed terms, renewal and plan changes

blocks.text: A monthly one-time purchase provides exactly 30 days of access. The yearly access model is one calendar year, subject to future approval of yearly prices and allowance timing. The order history shows the applicable start and expiry dates.

Purchases do not auto-renew and do not authorize recurring charges or a recurring mandate. You must make a separate purchase to renew. An early manual renewal starts after the existing paid term expires. A purchase of a different plan also starts after existing paid access expires; it does not upgrade or downgrade the current term early. Early upgrades, proration and unused-time credits are not offered under the current approved policy.

Expiry stops operations requiring current paid access without deleting historical research merely because access ended. A renewal reminder is a convenience and does not extend access. The retention and export provisions below apply separately.

Plan allowances, daily safety limits and capacity limits are distinct. The workspace usage view shows the applicable period and remaining capacity. Scheduled checks consume the applicable search and monitor allowances. AI operation counts, reserved token capacity, reported provider tokens and estimated provider cost are separate measurements; an estimate is not a guarantee of actual cost or complete token reporting.

Limits are enforced on the server. Retries reuse the relevant operation record where supported; an uncertain provider outcome may retain reserved capacity until reconciled. The service can refuse further operations when capacity is exhausted, access expires or a safety limit is reached. Existing saved research is retained according to the approved retention policy. Do not bypass limits, share credentials to evade seat restrictions, or manipulate client state to obtain unpurchased access.

Cancelling a hosted checkout before payment confirmation does not cancel a previously captured payment. Letting fixed-term access expire does not create an automatic renewal charge. Account closure, access expiry, cancellation of an in-progress checkout and refund of a completed purchase are separate actions.

For an initial paid purchase, you may request a refund within seven days of verified payment by contacting contact@planebyte.com or using Request refund review in Billing & Usage. Include the order reference and the reason without card details. We review the purchase, billing errors, duplicate charges and applicable rights before deciding the request. The initial-purchase window does not remove any additional right required by applicable law. No automatic renewal refund, undisclosed usage-percentage exception, universal no-refund rule or guaranteed bank-settlement deadline is imposed. Renewals and other requests remain subject to the applicable agreement and mandatory rights; a request is not rejected merely because the application cannot automate its review.

A recorded refund review request does not mean a refund has been approved or paid. Refund status must be independently established with the payment provider. A full refund verified in the original payment currency revokes access attributable to that purchase while preserving its accounting record and saved research. Partial refunds and missing currency evidence require review; they do not silently create a credit or a new access period. Mandatory rights under applicable law are not excluded.

You retain your rights in content you provide. You authorize processing of that content to operate the requested service, secure the account, provide support and perform the workflows you authorize, as described in the Privacy Policy. You must have the necessary rights and permissions for that content.

PlaneByte retains its rights in the service, software and branding. Your access permits use within the purchased or trial scope; it does not transfer ownership of the software. Third-party materials remain subject to their owners' rights. AI output may not be unique and is not a representation that all underlying material is exclusively owned by you or PlaneByte.

Do not use the service unlawfully, infringe others' rights, bypass access controls, impersonate another person, attempt unauthorized security testing, extract private content without permission, or interfere with another workspace. Do not use credentials, integrations, sources or developer tools beyond their authorized scope.

Product access does not authorize cold outreach, mass messaging or disregard of consent, opt-outs and suppression requirements. Features unavailable in your workspace must not be accessed through direct API calls or workers. Report a suspected vulnerability privately to contact@planebyte.com without exposing customer information.

We may restrict activity necessary to address account compromise, unlawful use, material misuse, provider restrictions or risks to the service or other users. We will provide an explanation and a route to support when lawful and practicable. A temporary restriction is not authority to erase retained customer or accounting records.

Service availability depends in part on third-party infrastructure and providers. No uninterrupted service, service-level credit, compliance certification or particular performance commitment is promised unless a separate written agreement expressly supplies one. We may maintain and improve the service; changes affecting paid access are subject to the applicable purchase agreement, approved refund policy and mandatory rights.

You may download personal account details and use the available workspace research exports, or request a full export through Sign-in & Security or contact@planebyte.com. Once account closure is verified through the review process, ordinary account data is scheduled for deletion or anonymization within 30 days, subject to the exceptions below. Backups are removed through their normal retention cycle, targeted at no more than 90 days after verified closure. Access expiry alone is not a closure request, and a submitted request does not immediately erase a workspace.

Submit an authenticated data request in Settings → Account → Sign-in & Security, or contact contact@planebyte.com. The application records a case reference. Support verifies identity, organizational authority, the requested scope and applicable retention exceptions before confirming closure or deletion. Additional information is requested only as needed for a proportionate review. Verified closure starts the tracked retention deadlines; no deletion is claimed until the case has been fulfilled and verified. Contact the same channel with the case reference for status or escalation. Deletion may be limited by applicable legal obligations, payment/refund records, disputes, fraud/security needs, legal holds, and the need to preserve contact history and suppression records. A member's deletion request must not automatically remove records controlled by another authorized workspace or erase evidence required to honor an opt-out. We will explain applicable limitations through the approved process.

Use reasonable care in evaluating source material and AI output, preserving your own necessary records, and managing authorized users. We remain responsible for obligations that applicable law does not permit us to exclude. Nothing in these Terms removes mandatory consumer or data-protection rights, excuses fraud or willful misconduct, or limits liability where such a limitation would be unlawful. No monetary liability cap, indemnity or exclusive foreign court is imposed by these Terms.

We will identify the published version and effective date of these Terms. Material changes requiring renewed acceptance will be presented through the account or purchase flow before they apply as required by the applicable agreement and law. A revised price does not silently authorize a charge or alter a previously verified order.

Contact contact@planebyte.com to raise a service or billing concern and provide the relevant workspace/order reference without sending passwords, verification codes or card details. Formal notices use the contracting identity and address in section 1. Applicable mandatory law and lawful rights to seek regulatory or judicial remedies remain available; no unapproved governing-law or venue clause is invented. If a provision cannot lawfully apply, the remaining lawful provisions continue to operate. A separately signed agreement governs only to the extent it expressly varies these Terms for the relevant customer.

This Policy explains the account, workspace, research, security and payment information processed for PlaneByte Intent Radar and Growth Intelligence, and related customer support. PlaneByte is operated by **Planebyte, an individually operated business owned by Piyush Agrawal**, with its legal-notice/business address at **House No. 1005, Attabira, Bargarh, Odisha 768027, India**. Support, privacy requests and grievances may be sent to contact@planebyte.com. Our business website is https://planebyte.com and the application is https://app.planebyte.com.

Where an organization controls information uploaded to its workspace, it may determine the purposes and permitted users of that information. PlaneByte operates the service on its behalf and also processes account administration, service security and transaction records for the purposes described here. A separate applicable data-processing agreement or mandatory law may specify additional responsibilities. A workspace member's personal rights and a workspace owner's authority are not interchangeable.

This Policy does not authorize an unconnected third-party integration, unpublished product, outreach campaign or provider access. Third-party websites, Google and PayU also provide their own applicable privacy notices. Marketing-site analytics or nonessential tracking, if introduced, require an accurate inventory and separate notice/consent where required; this draft does not assert that every marketing-site script has been audited.

table: Company email, name, company name, verified-email status and the sign-in method supplied by you or verified Google claims.

A securely hashed local password when configured; verification/recovery records; session and revocation records; consent-version records; abuse/rate-limit and security events. Google passwords are not collected by PlaneByte.
Workspace/company profile, roles, invitations, membership, onboarding progress, preferences and authorized integration references.

Company websites, reviewed ICPs, offerings, keywords, questions, assistant conversations, source excerpts, URLs, publication/collection dates, saved signals, opportunities, monitors and reports. These come from you, authorized workspace users and permitted sources.
Operation/job states, quota reservations and settlements, reported provider tokens, available cost estimates, errors and bounded operational diagnostics.

Plan and price snapshots, billing contact/address supplied for checkout, currency and total, order and provider references, test/live classification, payment verification, access dates, receipts and refund-review/reconciliation records. Card details are entered on PayU's hosted pages.
Transactional delivery identifiers, delivery/bounce/complaint events, suppression information and enquiries you send to support.

blocks.text: Verification and recovery credentials are short-lived. Verification values used for comparison are protected with one-way cryptographic checks; message content can temporarily exist in encrypted transactional delivery storage so the requested email can be delivered. Plaintext local passwords are not stored. Do not include payment-card details, passwords, private keys or verification codes in support enquiries or research prompts.

We use the information needed to provide the service you request: verify and secure accounts; provision the correct workspace and roles; preserve onboarding progress; run authorized research and AI tasks; save and retrieve results; account for usage; verify payments; activate and expire fixed-term access; reconcile refunds; deliver necessary account/billing messages; handle support; and maintain the service.

We also use appropriate records to prevent fraud and abuse, investigate incidents and disputes, enforce source and workspace permissions, and meet applicable legal obligations. Where consent is required, we obtain it for the specified purpose and provide the applicable withdrawal route. Where another lawful basis is permitted and appropriate, processing is limited to that basis. Acceptance of general Terms is not treated as blanket consent to unrelated marketing or every future use.

Research relevance or intent labels are interpretations of available evidence. They are not conclusive decisions about an individual or a guarantee that someone wants to be contacted. Workspace users must review results and ensure their subsequent use is lawful.

Google sign-in supplies the verified identity claims needed to authenticate you. It does not automatically authorize access to Gmail, Google Sheets or a company's records. Additional integrations require the permissions and authorization applicable to that connection. Credentials for supported customer connections stay on the server and are subject to workspace ownership checks.

Workspace roles determine which authorized users can see or manage workspace information. Owners and administrators may manage membership within their authority. An email-domain match does not automatically join an account to an existing workspace. Linking a password and Google identity requires an authenticated process; an email match alone does not authorize merging accounts.

Authorized research can retrieve public or otherwise permitted material from operational sources. Records can include usernames or author references, professional/company information, quotations, URLs and timestamps where the source provides them and the workflow permits their use. Public availability does not mean unrestricted reuse or erase individuals' applicable rights. Source coverage is described in the application; unavailable or unapproved connections are not represented as operational.

When you request an AI feature, the relevant company context, task instructions and source excerpts may be sent to the configured AI provider to produce the requested result. The current primary AI infrastructure is Google Cloud Vertex AI. AI responses can be incomplete or inaccurate. Review suggestions before saving or acting on them. We do not represent a source quote as an AI-verified fact, or claim a provider training/retention opt-out that has not been contractually verified. Provider-specific processing controls must be reflected accurately in the published disclosures and applicable agreements.

sections.title: 6. Service providers, disclosures and processing locations

blocks.text: The current architecture uses Vercel for the application frontend, Google Cloud for the API/workers and Vertex AI, Neon PostgreSQL for stored application data, PayU for hosted payments, and Netlify for the separate marketing website. Resend delivers transactional account messages. Payment processing is unavailable until the specific merchant permissions and checkout acceptance have been verified; including PayU in this disclosure does not mean checkout is open.

Providers receive information relevant to the function they perform. The application API/workers are deployed in India and the current database region is in the United States; other provider processing depends on the applicable service configuration and agreements. Do not infer that all information remains in one country. Applicable cross-border processing requirements and provider disclosures must be verified before publication.

We may disclose information to authorized workspace users, necessary service providers, professional advisers handling a relevant matter, or public authorities where disclosure is lawfully required. We may also preserve or disclose appropriate records to investigate security incidents, fraud, disputes or legal claims. Such disclosures must be limited to the relevant purpose and authority. This Policy does not authorize sale of workspace content or unrestricted disclosure to data partners.

The application uses essential session cookies and security mechanisms for authentication and protection of account actions. It may store functional preferences such as theme, navigation state and workspace context. Production authentication cookies are protected against ordinary client-side access and use secure transport settings.

Disabling essential cookies can prevent sign-in and account functions from working. A theme preference is separate from permission to perform research, access a source, process a payment or send outreach. Any nonessential analytics or advertising technology requires its own accurate disclosure and applicable consent controls; no advertising or analytics consent is bundled into an account verification code.

Account verification, password recovery, explicit team invitations, payment confirmations, renewal/expiry notices and important security messages support the requested service. Delivery is bounded, deduplicated and subject to suppression and authorization checks. A queued message does not establish that it arrived; delivery and complaint events may be processed from the configured email provider.

General workspace notifications require the relevant enabled feature and recipient preferences. Bulk outreach and marketing are separate from transactional messages and are not authorized merely by enabling account email delivery. An opt-out or suppression record may need to be retained so the choice continues to be honored. The approved deletion process below will explain the scope of such retention.

sections.title: 9. Retention after expiry or account closure

blocks.text: Fixed-term access expires at its recorded time without automatically deleting saved research, payment history or other retained records. Workspace closure, personal account closure, expiry, membership removal and a verified deletion request have different effects.

After verified account closure, ordinary account data is scheduled for deletion or anonymization within 30 days, subject to justified exceptions below. Backup removal follows the normal retention cycle, targeted at no more than 90 days after verified closure. These targets come from the owner’s launch policy. The operator records closure and its deadlines; submitting a request alone does not execute a purge. Existing workspace exports and a personal account-detail download are available, and a fuller export can be requested for review.

Retention must account for the purpose and applicable obligations for each record category. Accounting/refund records, consent and security records, legal holds/disputes, contact/message history and suppression information can require different treatment from an unused research draft. Backups are recovery copies; any eventual deletion process must define how deletions remain effective after recovery and how retained backup copies age out, without promising immediate removal from every copy.

Depending on applicable law and your relationship with the workspace, you may have rights to obtain information about processing, access or correct your personal information, request erasure, withdraw consent, raise a grievance, or use other rights available to you. A workspace administrator can help with organizational records within that administrator's authority. Applicable rights are not limited to the application controls currently available.

Use Settings → Account → Sign-in & Security to submit an authenticated full-export, account-closure/deletion or erasure-review request, or contact contact@planebyte.com. The application acknowledges the request with a reference. Support reviews identity, workspace authority and retention exceptions, requests proportionate clarification where needed, and records verified closure and the applicable 30/90-day targets. Use the case reference with the same contact for status, correction or escalation. Request handling also observes any additional applicable legal requirements. No named privacy officer or legally required designation is invented.

Use the approved channel and provide enough context to locate the relevant account/workspace without sending a password, OTP or unnecessary identity document. Verification should be proportionate and prevent one person from deleting another person's or organization's records. We will explain any valid reason a request cannot be completed in full and any available escalation or review route under the approved process and applicable law.

Deletion or withdrawal may affect features that need the relevant information. Retention may remain necessary for payment/refund and legal records, fraud/security investigations, dispute resolution, lawful holds, contact history or suppression choices. No blanket exception permits keeping every record indefinitely, and no request automatically authorizes a production reset or deletion of another workspace. Closing access is not a substitute for implementing and verifying an approved deletion request.

The service uses workspace authorization, protected authentication/session records, server-side secret handling, access controls and protected storage/transit mechanisms appropriate to the relevant component. No system can guarantee absolute security. We do not claim a security certification or guarantee against every incident.

We investigate suspected incidents, take appropriate containment and recovery measures, and provide notifications required by applicable law and the relevant agreement. Contact contact@planebyte.com if you suspect unauthorized access, and avoid disclosing another person's information or credentials in the report. Support, privacy and security escalation use contact@planebyte.com, addressed to the business owner, Piyush Agrawal.

The service is intended for authorized business use. It is not designed to solicit children's personal information. If information appears to have been supplied without the authority or lawful consent required for that person, contact us so it can be assessed through the approved request process. No unapproved age threshold or guardian-consent mechanism is asserted by this draft.

The published Policy will identify its version and effective date. Material changes will be communicated as required, and additional consent will be obtained where the applicable processing requires it. A policy update does not silently authorize unrelated outreach, a payment or a new source connection.

Support and privacy contact: contact@planebyte.com, addressed to Piyush Agrawal, business owner. Responsible business: Planebyte (Individual), House No. 1005, Attabira, Bargarh, Odisha 768027, India. Use the request and escalation process in section 10. Mandatory rights and lawful access to an appropriate authority remain available.

You may request a refund for an initial prepaid purchase within seven days of verified payment. Submit Request refund review in Settings → Billing & Usage, or email contact@planebyte.com with your order reference and the reason. Do not send passwords, OTPs or card details. The policy applies to the initial purchase; additional rights required by applicable law remain available for every purchase.

The request is reviewed against the actual purchase, payment evidence, service circumstances and applicable rights. The seven-day window is not an unreviewed promise that every request has already been approved. No undisclosed usage-percentage condition is imposed. If a request cannot be approved in full, we explain the reason and the available support/escalation route. No blanket exclusion of mandatory rights is intended.

sections.title: Billing errors, duplicates and uncertain payments

blocks.text: Contact us about an incorrect or duplicate charge even if you are unsure whether the initial-purchase window applies. We reconcile the specific transactions before deciding what action is appropriate. A pending payment is not assumed successful. Check your payment history and contact support before paying again when a prior result is uncertain.

A recorded request is an acknowledgement of review, not proof that money was refunded. PayU processes the financial transaction. A refund is treated as completed only after independent provider verification; actual banking credit timing can vary. We do not promise a settlement deadline that the provider has not confirmed.

sections.title: Renewal, future terms and yearly access

blocks.text: Access is prepaid for a fixed term and does not automatically renew. A separately purchased renewal or future term is a separate transaction, subject to its agreement and applicable rights. No automatic unused-time credit, early-upgrade proration or automatic refund of an unused future term is promised. You may still request review, and mandatory rights remain preserved.

Yearly checkout is unavailable until exact yearly prices and allowance timing are approved and published. This policy does not invent a yearly amount or discount. Once yearly purchases are enabled, the published initial-purchase request window and any additional applicable rights must be presented with those terms before purchase.

A full refund independently confirmed in the original purchase currency revokes the access attributable to that purchase. It does not delete saved research, another purchase or the original accounting record. Partial refunds and missing currency evidence require review; they do not automatically create a new entitlement or a credit balance. Payment/refund and other justified retention exceptions are explained in the Privacy Policy.
Contact contact@planebyte.com with the case/order reference for status or escalation. Nothing in this policy limits rights that applicable law does not permit us to exclude.

The current service uses one-time purchases for fixed-term access. A monthly purchase provides exactly 30 days. The yearly model is one calendar year, but yearly checkout is unavailable until exact prices and allowance timing are approved. Neither option creates an automatically renewing subscription or a recurring auto-debit mandate.

You may choose not to renew at any time. No cancellation action is needed to stop an automatic charge because the current offering does not make automatic renewal charges. Access continues until the end of the term already purchased, unless a verified refund, security restriction or other lawful agreement condition applies. A renewal reminder does not authorize a payment or extend the term.

Leaving or cancelling an in-progress PayU checkout does not establish whether a bank captured funds. Review the payment history and allow server-side reconciliation. A cancellation screen does not refund an already captured payment, and an uncertain result should be checked before creating another purchase.

An early manual renewal starts after existing paid access ends. A separately purchased different plan also begins after existing paid access ends. There is no current early-upgrade, proration or unused-time credit policy. Choosing not to make another renewal does not cancel a separately purchased future term; request review under the Refund Policy if needed.

You may request account closure, a full export or erasure review through Settings → Account → Sign-in & Security or contact@planebyte.com. The request is recorded and reviewed for identity, workspace authority and retained-record obligations. It does not immediately delete data, remove another user's records or issue a refund. Ordinary account data is scheduled for deletion/anonymization within 30 days after verified closure, with backup aging targeted within 90 days, subject to justified exceptions in the Privacy Policy.

Expiry of access alone preserves saved research under the applicable retention policy. Closure of a personal account and the handling of an organization's workspace are separate matters; organizational authority must be verified. Contact support before closure if you need help exporting records or transferring authorized workspace ownership.

For refund review, use the separate Refund Policy, including its seven-day initial-purchase request window and any additional mandatory rights. For questions or escalation, contact contact@planebyte.com with the order or request reference. No password, OTP or card details are required in that message.
